method: Manual anatomical localization in native pixel-art source/review grids; nearby visible-pixel refinement within 3px in a hand-only ROI; no art pixel moved or synthesized. Native source palm/wrist coordinates preserved.

ledgeCatch.measurement: Black fingerless glove palm pad anatomically identified in real native source and normalized cell; only nearby actual pixels selected for a visible 9x9 neighborhood. Exposed fingers are visible above/outside pad. Project contact adaptation, not an official RE5 anchor.

wrist.measurement: Actual adjoining glove cuff/forearm wrist; anatomically identified before local visible-pixel refinement.
